correctness.summary: Reviewed all current WSClean/Radler diffs, the four full regression files, scripts/test.sh, relevant callers, requirements and plotting code. The earlier empty-range blocker is resolved through guarded initialization and documented epoch errors; skipped MODEL reads now have coverage. No additional concrete defects found. Plot labels match retained results, including 4K old/new T2 failures. Inspected saved reports only; ran no tests and changed no files. Threaded gridder/scheduler implementations excluded.

suggestions.suggestion: Assert adjust_nthreads(8)==8 for fixed-eight-thread acceptance; participation>1 permits reduced concurrency.
Extend independent numerical coverage to mixed precision, shifted centres, coordinate flips and omitted weights/masks.
Add an end-to-end gridder exception test after scanning while deferred tile helpers are active.
Complete idle-host performance/RSS measurements for channel scanning, per-block allocation and batch barriers.

threaded.summary: Inspected the entire two-file Schaapcommon diff, both complete regression tests, scripts/test.sh integration, requirements, prior review-threaded-v2.json and surrounding production paths. No blocking defect found. Under reject-before-accept semantics, callback-construction and submission failures count down unaccepted jobs, drain accepted workers and bare-rethrow the original exception, including when draining workers throw. Shared callback, scheduler and partial-helper lifetimes remain valid; exception publication is synchronized and reuse is covered. Canonical bucket sorting precedes subdivision, channel scanning establishes tile/minplane containment, and caller-ordered merging limits live tile helpers to 32. Nonfinite guards and uninstrumented repeats remain. Inspected saved passing normal/ASan/UBSan/TSan scheduler logs and the 597-check gridder log; did not execute regression or heavy tests. Executed shell-syntax and diff-whitespace checks successfully. This is code approval only: full suites remain with the parent, and the initial 4K old/new T2 failure remains recorded and unwaived.
